reviewer: Same implementation agent after freezing scanner1f3f72f; no independent human or unseen-source claim.
condition: The registered auth_fetch tool rejects a caller-supplied http://[::ffff:7f00:1]/ URL before the initial browser navigation when private destinations have not been opted into
prerequisites: Use the normal upstream stdio entrypoint, source-locked MCP SDK1.27.1 and Playwright1.58.2, with AUTH_FETCH_ALLOW_PRIVATE and AUTH_FETCH_ALLOW_HOSTS unset. No source monkeypatch, custom proxy, browser route hook or external destination policy. Nothing is executed in this evaluation.

Invoke auth_fetch with url=http://[::ffff:7f00:1]/ and wait_for omitted. The genuine registered Zod string schema admits this string. Browser startup succeeds and provides a context; a fresh blank page is available or can be created.

The exact input is already the hex-normalized IPv4-mapped loopback form. Brackets are removed by the guard; node:net classifies ::ffff:7f00:1 as IPv6, so the literal-IP branch avoids DNS. Empty opt-in/allowlist values do not bypass policy.

The scored boundary is rejection before page.goto. A reachable loopback service, capture-button click, successful page load, returned content, redirects, DNS/rebinding, other embedded-IPv4 formats and download_media are outside the named condition. Browser/runtime availability is a prerequisite, not a measured success.
flow: index McpServer -> registerTools -> auth_fetch string argument -> getOrLaunchBrowser -> navigateTo(ctx,url) -> imported assertSafeUrl -> literal IPv6 guard -> returned URL -> page.goto. Capture interaction occurs afterward and is outside the condition.
difference_from_exposed: Independent auth-fetch-mcp repository with Playwright browser navigation and a guard returning a parsed URL, hexadecimal mapped-address reconstruction and CIDR arithmetic. It shares the SSRF family and mapped-loopback concept with exposed open-webSearch; this is not an independent vulnerability family.
correlation: Two original source revisions and their two reversible renames concern one vulnerability. The safe control shares the fixed tree; five inputs are not five independent vulnerabilities.
source_judgment: Named validators alone do not establish protection; the exact literal and source branches determine these narrow labels. DNS, redirects and other embedded address forms remain outside scope.
